trust_decision.summary: The removeScriptElement plugin decides which elements/attributes of untrusted SVG count as executable and strips them. At the pinned commit it only checks a fixed SVG event-attribute list and `javascript:` hrefs on <a>, and does nothing for HTML inside <foreignObject>.

landing_point.why: The advisory names removeScripts and foreignObject event/HTML attributes; the event-attribute deletion loop in the plugin is the obvious first place to look.

fix_sites.module_kind: plugin (attribute stripping on enter): adds foreignObject depth tracking, on*/srcdoc/executable-URL removal
plugin (anchor collapse on exit): namespace-aware <a> plus isExecutableUrl instead of javascript: prefix

fix_sites.entry_point: exported helper hasScripts, used by cleanupIds (plugins/cleanupIds.js:159), minifyStyles (plugins/minifyStyles.js:64), removeHiddenElems (plugins/removeHiddenElems.js:147), removeUselessStrokeAndFill (plugins/removeUselessStrokeAndFill.js:30), all in preset-default
fix_sites.module_kind: shared tools module: second copy of the javascript: href check, plus the new isExecutableUrl helper (fix.diff:24-72)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/svgo/tools.js:160-171 (hasScripts duplicates the `javascript:` href test; fix.diff:80-92 switches it to isExecutableUrl)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: hasScripts only decides whether other optimisation plugins hold back on script-bearing nodes; it removes nothing, so a solver can argue it is not part of the removeScripts sanitiser. For O8, the plugin docs scope event removal to 'SVG event attributes' (docs/03-plugins/remove-scripts.mdx:20), and XML is case-sensitive, so an uppercase or unlisted event name looks like a non-issue.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Visual foreignObject HTML must survive: elements, style, class, title and non-executable src stay; data:image/png anchors stay uncollapsed; <a>/<foreignObject>/srcdoc in unrelated namespaces stay. An over-broad fix that drops all foreignObject content, all data: URLs or all on*/href attributes breaks these.
O5_coupled_behaviour.where: fix.diff:290-305 (PNG data anchor kept), fix.diff:321-355 (iframe src kept, custom:foreignObject srcdoc kept), fix.diff:384-399 (custom:a kept)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Event attributes on SVG elements outside foreignObject that are missing from the fixed list (e.g. onpointerdown, onanimationstart, onwheel, onauxclick, onbeforetoggle) are still kept, because outside foreignObject the check is exact membership in eventAttrs.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The docs promise removal of 'SVG event attributes' (docs/03-plugins/remove-scripts.mdx:20) and the list is taken from the SVG 1.1 attribute groups (plugins/_collections.js:152-163, 238-304); HTML-only events look like a neighbouring feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point; list lives in plugins/_collections.js

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Mixed-case event attribute names outside foreignObject (e.g. onLoad) skip the exact-case check; HTML parsers lowercase them when the SVG is inlined in HTML.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: SVG is XML and case-sensitive, so a solver can argue onLoad is not an event attribute in a standalone .svg.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Mixed-case script element names (e.g. SCRIPT inside foreignObject HTML) are not matched, because the element name test is exact-case.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Element names are case-sensitive in XML; the advisory is about attributes, not about <script>, which already 'works'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: SVG animation elements (<set>/<animate> with attributeName=href and to/values holding a javascript: URL) can retarget an <a> href, and the plugin never checks to/values/from.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Animation is a separate SVG feature and the anchor check is written against static href attributes only; browser support for this route is unclear.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file; animation attrs defined in plugins/_collections.js:137-145

O8b_injection_room.sibling: hasScripts recomputes its own event list and does not know about foreignObject HTML on*/srcdoc; a sibling helper with a private javascript:-only check would be realistic.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pinned tree already duplicates the javascript: check in two files (lib/svgo/tools.js:165, plugins/removeScriptElement.js:114-117), so a third copy elsewhere is in keeping with how the code is written.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Collapse or strip executable hrefs on other SVG navigation/load elements (e.g. an xlink:href check limited to <a>, with a parallel element added in our copy), sharing a private prefix test instead of isExecutableUrl.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The anchor branch is a hand-rolled per-element check; adding a second element with its own inline check is a natural maintainer change.
